dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Have a cup of tea first. There's no need to rush this. Just take your time to hone your skills and think over the solutions, and one day it'll all come together, and you'll find the inspiration you need.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to work on my skills some more.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Look at you! Looks like someone's developed a taste for shooting...

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: The regular practices probably aren't cutting it for you anymore. How about I bring in a real pro and you two can pit your skills against each other?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure!

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: That settles it, then. I'll go get Ursula!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm a little busy at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Next time, then!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Work on my skills!

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Whoa, it looks like you found your rhythm after just a few practice shots. That's some talent you've got there...

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Up for another round of target practice?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Of course!

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: That's the spirit! Give me just a second to get everything set up... I'll be ready for you in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm a little busy at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Next time, then!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Work on my skills?

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Well, since you clearly look like you belong on a battlefield, I'd say refining your marksmanship skills is exactly the kind of practice you need.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: The best marksmen grow up on lead and gunpowder. Skip just one day of practice, your aim starts to slip.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: What do you say to a quick round? See how you're feeling today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Give me a second, then. I'll get the training rounds and targets prepped...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm a little busy at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Next time, then!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I really like your relaxed, take-it-easy approach to things!

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Thank you. It's something I learned from Lisa.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Although she left 8th Company long ago... I'll always respect her, no matter what happens at work or elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Even my close friend Ursula doesn't think about work all the time anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: But Hedwig, who was my bunkmate when I first joined the unit, just won't listen. Every single day, she's out there pushing herself to the limit.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Seriously... You've got to pace yourself. Pushing yourself that hard won't do you any good...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of inspiration are we talking about here?

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm a gunsmith. For me, the inspiration I'm chasing is... the best way to improve musket performance, I guess?

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Every musket is a whole system. That means that whenever you make a modification, you have to consider its impact on the rest of the system.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: But if you try to graft something from a new patent onto an existing platform just because, you'll run into far more complications than you've bargained for.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: The musket recently adopted by the Knights of Favonius is a reliable and cost-effective model that's been tested and proven in numerous battles by Snezhnaya and Fontaine...

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: But we still have some way to go to make it better so that our knights to take on every enemy safely.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: And when you've pushed a musket's modifications as far as they can go, it's a sign to rethink the entire design.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Coming up with a completely new platform from scratch sounds more promising, don't you think?

choices.text: But wouldn't that be really costly?

response.speaker: Herstal
response.text: Well... Money and time aren't our biggest roadblocks. Our greatest obstacle here is mindset — one that wants the prize without having to go through the process of earning it.

response.speaker: Herstal
response.text: I'll write to the Captain, and maybe even the Grand Master, about funding. Then, I'll have to recruit a few more assistants...

choices.text: I'm guessing that process would take a long time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm off to tea, then.

dialogues.speaker: Herstal
dialogues.text: Take care!
